senses.gloss:
Dhīragodāvaramiśra
See Godāvaramiśra, NCC. VI. p. 126.

Dhīragovindaśarman
--Ātharvaṇa(Atharvaṇa)rahasya.
See NCC. VI. p. 207b.

Dhīrajarāja
--Cikitsāsāra. Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 40. [Page299-b]

Dhīratoṣiṇī
name of C. by Govindarāma Siddhāntavāgīśa on Ānandalaharī (Saundaryalaharī). Dacca 462. C.

Dhīradeva
son of Abhayapāla an. preceptor of Śrī Govindācārya (a. of Rasasāra, BORI. D. XVI. i. 220).

Dhīradhīra
of the Śāṇḍilyavam3śa; father of Gadādhara (a. of C. Sudhāmadhu on Naiṣadhīyacarita. Trav. Uni. 7144).

Dhīranāga
son of Karaṇika Thīruka; a. of Harṣa stone Ins. (d. 970 A. D.) of Chāhamāna Vigraharāja. Epi. Ind. II. p.. 116-25.

Dhīranāga
(Bhadanta) poet. Sbhv. 1064. 1142. 3389. Skm. p. 103 (Lahore edn.). no. 733 (Calcutta edn.).

Dhīranāga
or Vīranāga. sometimes confused with Diṅnāga.
--Kundamālā. drama. See NCC. IV. p. 196a. Also Pt.. Cal. Skt. College Res. Ser. 28. Text no. 15. Calcutta, 1964.

Dhīranāyaka
father of a.. a. of C. on Vṛttaratnākara, MT. 7515.

Dhīrabodhakasaṅgraha
Vaṅgīya Sup. 1772 (inc.).

Dhīramatī
queen of Darpanārāyaṇa (son of Narasim3hadeva), king of Kāmeśvara line of Mithilā; patronized Vidyāpati (a. of Dānavākyāvalī, Mithilā I. 192. 192 A-G).
See BP. p. 352; above p. 11b an. Kane, HDS. I. p. 398-9.

Dhīramāna
son of Rāmadeva an. father of Kārtikeya Siddhānta Bhaṭṭācārya (a. of C. on Mugdhabodha, RASB. VI. 4529). [Page300-a.

Dhīrarañjanikā
or Dhīrarañjīkā. name of C. by Govindarāmasiddhāntavāgīśa on Kumārasambhava. Pt.. Dacca, 1904.

Dhīravijaya
Jain.
--Maunaikādaśīkathā. BORI. 1160 of 1891-95.
--Maunaikādaśīmāhātmya. JBhP. I. 2118.

Dhīraśabaracarita
saṅgīta kāvya. story of Kaṇṇappa, the śaiva devotee. TCD. 1573G. Tra. Ad. Rep. 1106. 81. Trav. Uni. C. 2001 G. T. 936 (both with C.).

Dhīrasāyaśāstrin
--Ghaṭaśrāddhapaddhati. dh. CPB. 1596.
--Dvārapālapūjā. CPB. 2312.
--Navagrahahomavidhi. dh. CPB. 2479.
--Ṣoḍaśakārikā. gr. CPB. 6049-50.
--Saptāhapaddhati. dh. CPB. 6279.

Dhīrasiṃhadeva
king of Tīrabhukti, patron of Vācaspati Miśra (a. of Tīrthacintāmaṇi or Abhinavatīrthacintāmaṇi, Dacca 4082) an. of Madhusūdana (a. of Jyotiṣpradīpāṅkura, IO. 3004).
--Tīrthacintāmaṇi ascribed to him in SSPC. I. I. 166.

Dhīrasena
mentioned in the Mehesaracaria of Sim3hasena alias Raidhū (15th Cent.) (See Allahabad Uni. Studies I. (1925) 175); mentioned by Dhavala in his Harivam3śapurāṇa (Jain). See ‘Apabhram3śa Lit.’ Allahabad Uni. Studies I. (1925) 166.

Dhīrānandataraṅgiṇī
a novel in Skt. by Kṛṣṇacandra Nyāyavāgīśa.
Pt.. in Bengali script. Calcutta, 1887. IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1897, p. 73.

Dhīrāmodakarī
or Modakarī. name of C. by Kṛṣṇavipra or Kṛṣṇatarkālaṅkāra Bhaṭṭācārya on Dāyabhāga. Dacca 92. 1990. 2050B. [Page300-b]

Dhīrāvalī
Jain. Māg. Ujjain I. p. 88.

Dhīrāśramamāhātmya
paur. IIO. Stein 269.

Dhīrī
son of Nānū; father of Mādhava (territorial chief a. Lāvapura) an. patron of Maheśa Śarman (a. of Mādhavaprakāśa, IO. 1608).

Dhīrendrapañcībhūṣaṇa
son of Dharmeśvara.
--Nityakarmalatā. L. 2411.

Dhīrendrayati
--Viṣayavākyasaṅgraha. dh. Kṛṣṇapur 253.

Dhīreśa(miśra)
teacher of Nīlakaṇṭha (a. of Bhāratabhāvadīpa, Oxf. 1a an. C. Rudramīmām3sā on Rudrasārasaṅgraha, MT. 2070).

Dhīreśvara
father of Gaṇapati (a of Gaṅgābhaktitaraṅgiṇī, L. 1867).
See JASB. XI (1915) 406.

Dhīreśvara
father of Jyotirīśvara (a. of Dhūrtasamāgama).
See NCC. VII. p. 354a.

Dhīreśvara
--Dvijarājodaya. dh. Ujjain Latest Additions 435.

Dhīreśvara
--Buddhipradīpa. jy. Mithilā III. 219.

Dhīreśvara
son of Keśava Miśra.
--Vidyāmañjarī. poem in 2 chs. on merits of learning, composed in 1814 A. D. RASB. VII. 5518.

Dhīreśvarabhaṭṭācārya
Mm. born in 1853 a. Athghoria.
--Karṇakhādaka. metrical rendering of Assamese ‘Kānkhowa.’
--Poems on the death of Edward VII. an. on the coronation of George V.
--Līlāmañjarī. kāvya. [Page301-a.
--Vṛttamañjarī. with explanatory notes. Assam Kāvyas 43.
See J. of Gauhati Uni. XV. i. 1964, p. 87.
